Name: Valley of Lebanon
ModernLocation: The Beqaa valley between the Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon ranges
Description: The valley under Mount Hermon, between the Lebanon ranges, named as the northern end of Joshua's conquests. It is commonly identified with the Beqaa valley. The plain of Aven in Amos may be the same valley, but that identification is not certain, so it is noted here rather than given a separate entry.
BiblicalSignificance: The valley of Lebanon bounds Joshua's land to the north, under Hermon.
